description: This file defines a custom exception class GatewayAuthenticationFailedException used in the context of handling HTTP authentication failures within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes nested builder class, static factory methods, and metadata annotations.

classes.name: GatewayAuthenticationFailedException
classes.description: A final class representing an exception for failed gateway authentication, extending DittoRuntimeException and implementing GatewayException. It provides static methods for creating instances and a nested builder class.

classes.name: GatewayAuthenticationFailedException.Builder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe builder class for constructing GatewayAuthenticationFailedException instances with a fluent API.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance with a specified message.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a message and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated headers.
